انتزعتا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَزَعَتَا (intazaʕatā) /in.ta.za.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# اُنْتُزِعَتَا (untuziʕatā) /un.tu.zi.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
